name: tmforum-sid
label: TM Forum Open API / SID
description: Telecom BSS/OSS standard — used by every telecom operator globally
short_description: Telecom BSS/OSS standard — used by every telecom operator globally
long_description: TM Forum's Open API suite (formerly SID) provides the universal data model for telecommunications BSS/OSS systems, covering the complete telco product/service/resource stack. The schema covers party management, customer accounts, product catalog, service instances, resource inventory, and trouble ticket management — aligned with TMF620/TMF622/TMF629/TMF632 APIs.
when_to_use: Use for any telecom BSS/OSS application, MVNO platform, or telco API integration. TM Forum Open APIs are implemented by 850+ companies including AT&T, Deutsche Telekom, Orange, and Telefónica. Required for TM Forum Open API certification. Essential for MVNO management systems and telecom-as-a-service platforms.

table_notes.tmf_party: Root entity for any actor in the system (individual person, organization, or legal entity) per TMF632 Party Management API.
table_notes.tmf_customer: Links a party to a commercial customer account with billing state, credit limit, and lifecycle tracking per TMF629 Customer Management API.
table_notes.tmf_product: Catalog entry for a sellable product offering (voice plan, data bundle, device) with pricing and validity window per TMF620 Product Catalog API.
table_notes.tmf_service: Active service instance provisioned for a customer, binding a product to network/platform resources per TMF638 Service Inventory API.
table_notes.tmf_resource: Physical or logical network resource (SIM, IP address, port, node) underpinning a service instance per TMF639 Resource Inventory API.
table_notes.tmf_trouble_ticket: Customer-facing or internal fault or request ticket with priority, severity, and resolution lifecycle per TMF621 Trouble Ticket API.

tmf_party.name: party_type
tmf_party.description: Discriminator: 'Individual', 'Organization', or 'LegalEntity' per TMF632 party type coding

tmf_party.name: name
tmf_party.description: Full display name: legal name for organizations, given+family name for individuals

tmf_party.name: tax_exempt_certificate
tmf_party.description: Tax exemption certificate number; NULL means standard tax applies

tmf_party.name: credit_rating
tmf_party.description: Credit rating record(s): [{ratingAgency, ratingScore, validFor: {startDateTime, endDateTime}}]

tmf_party.name: is_active
tmf_party.description: Whether the party is currently active; false soft-deletes the record

tmf_customer.name: party_id
tmf_customer.description: References the underlying party (person or org) that owns this account

tmf_customer.name: account_number
tmf_customer.description: Human-readable billing account number; unique across all customers

tmf_customer.name: customer_since
tmf_customer.description: Date the customer relationship was established (used for tenure discounts and churn analysis)

tmf_customer.name: credit_limit
tmf_customer.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed before service suspension (in account currency)

tmf_customer.name: balance
tmf_customer.description: Current outstanding balance; negative means credit, positive means amount owed

tmf_product.name: name
tmf_product.description: Marketable product name shown to customers (e.g. 'Unlimited 5G Plan')

tmf_product.name: description
tmf_product.description: Full marketing description of the product offering

tmf_product.name: start_date
tmf_product.description: Date from which this product can be sold or provisioned

tmf_product.name: end_date
tmf_product.description: Date after which new subscriptions are no longer accepted (NULL = no expiry)

tmf_product.name: price
tmf_product.description: Base recurring or one-time price in the currency specified by the currency column

tmf_product.name: currency
tmf_product.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the price (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

tmf_product.name: characteristics
tmf_product.description: Flexible product attributes: [{name, value, valueType, unitOfMeasure}] per TMF620 ProductCharacteristic

tmf_service.name: customer_id
tmf_service.description: References the customer account that subscribes to this service

tmf_service.name: product_id
tmf_service.description: References the product offering that defines this service's commercial terms

tmf_service.name: started_at
tmf_service.description: Timestamp when the service was activated and began incurring charges

tmf_service.name: ended_at
tmf_service.description: Timestamp when the service was deactivated or terminated (NULL if still active)

tmf_service.name: attributes
tmf_service.description: Service-specific configuration: [{name, value}] e.g. MSISDN, IMSI, bandwidth, QoS class

tmf_resource.name: service_id
tmf_resource.description: References the service instance this resource is currently allocated to (NULL if unassigned)

tmf_resource.name: characteristics
tmf_resource.description: Technical attributes: [{name, value, valueType}] e.g. IMEI, MAC address, VLAN, IP address

tmf_resource.name: place
tmf_resource.description: Physical location: {streetNr, streetName, city, stateOrProvince, country, geographicPoint}

tmf_trouble_ticket.name: ticket_number
tmf_trouble_ticket.description: Human-readable ticket reference shown to customers and agents (e.g. INC-20240501-0042)

tmf_trouble_ticket.name: customer_id
tmf_trouble_ticket.description: References the customer account that raised or is affected by this ticket

tmf_trouble_ticket.name: title
tmf_trouble_ticket.description: Short summary of the fault or request (shown in ticket list views)

tmf_trouble_ticket.name: description
tmf_trouble_ticket.description: Full symptom description, steps to reproduce, and contextual detail provided by reporter

tmf_trouble_ticket.name: created_at
tmf_trouble_ticket.description: Timestamp when the ticket was first created (auto-set to server time)

tmf_trouble_ticket.name: resolved_at
tmf_trouble_ticket.description: Timestamp when the fault was resolved or request fulfilled (NULL if still open)
